# aphrody_av crate

Source: https://docs.aphrody.com/crates/aphrody_av/

Pure-Rust FFmpeg replacement: probe, decode, encode, remux, transcode and convert for any agent, library, language or OS (Rust API, CLI, C ABI, UniFFI, wasm, MCP).

## Workspace dependencies

[`fw-video`](/crates/fw-video/). It also uses 11 crates from outside the workspace.

## Features

`cli`, `default`, `ffi`, `header`, `mcp`, `threads`, `uniffi`, `uniffi-cli`, `wasm`

## Build

Run this from the repository root.

```bash
cargo build --release -p aphrody_av
```
